pages.text: Tobacco plants grow on tilled farmland and produce $(bold)Tobacco Leaves$() when harvested. Dry them in the $(bold)Drying Rack$() or $(bold)Dryer machine$() to create $(bold)Dried Tobacco Leaves$(). Process dried leaves further to get $(bold)Tobacco$() — the ingredient for Joints.$(br)$(br)$(bold)Processing chain:$()$(br)Tobacco Leaves → (dry) → Dried Tobacco Leaves → (grind) → Tobacco$(br)$(br)Tobacco is also sellable to the $(bold)Stoner villager$() for emeralds.
